comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
Since Guilder already listed the info, i'm just gonna fill new information.

The real name is "Legendary Key Staff". Club/Staff type Weapon.
You can obtain this on regular map, apparently. I managed to get it from Candia's SoW, so i'm not sure if you can get it from Alexandria's SoW.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: Did 4 runs in Candia SoW so far and got this 3 out of the 4 times, the last run got 3 of them.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This weapon is a club-staff type and only comes from treasure chests in Candia's Sea of Wonders -- it is an uncommon drop from all three floors, and sometimes drops from the rare sea region's special chests as well.

It cannot currently be traded and can be sacrificed to unlock/accept the Legend Regarding an Old Map Treasure Hunt theme; see details on its page.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Just a quick FYI: This item will be important in Chapter 3: Pharos as the Lighthouse route relic discovery The Ancient Reflector is used as a Legacy clue.

comments.author: Kurama
comments.body:
So, mates. Just to be sure, i can acctually pick it from the common chest in the area?

Cuz i'm getting just trash like broken cannons.

I don't really need to fight the boss to pick it, right?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Correct. It is an "uncommon" drop from regular sea chests, and semi-frequent from the rare green sea map's special chests. Keep visiting the Sea of Wonders off Candia and you'll have this item before long. Even if you did fight the boss, this item does not drop from it. Cheers.

comments.author: Scara
comments.body:
The staff dont drop if you have any treasure hunt theme on.
I spent the past week running Candia SoW for that staff and didnt get any. Today I discarded the TH theme I had on, I got 1 on first run.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: Really? I always have TH active on my main and alts; I have gotten 20+ keys in one month's time and they received keys at different times as well. I really wish this item could be traded so I could share them with other players. :(

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Platinum ore used to be untradeable, but players suggested it to Papaya, and KOEI approved its no-trade status being changed. Perhaps it would be worth trying again in regards to this item? Just a thought; nothing is ever guaranteed. Cheers.

comments.author: viller
comments.body: Well, i don't know if it was a coincidence or not, but after many many tries to get the staff i discarded the TH theme i was working on and...the second chest droped it! TY Scara for the tip!
